summary: Bending Spoons S.p.A., via wholly-owned subsidiary Bending Spoons US Inc., agreed on September 10, 2026 to acquire RealTimeBoard, Inc. (d/b/a Miro) in an all-cash reverse triangular merger, with Merger Sub merging into Miro and Miro surviving as a wholly-owned Bending Spoons subsidiary. The deal values Miro at a $1.355 billion enterprise value which, with Miro's net cash, implies roughly $1.79 billion equity value, subject to customary purchase-price adjustments. Certain Miro shareholders will reinvest $295 million of proceeds into newly issued Bending Spoons equity. Closing is expected in Q4 2026, subject to regulatory approvals; outside date September 10, 2027. Watch antitrust/regulatory clearance and the equity rollover's signal on seller conviction.
